Title: Kunal and the Family

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Kunal: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Kunal (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Kunal drinks a glass of water.]

Kunal (surprised): "Really?"

[Kunal sips hot tea from a cup.]

Kunal: "Let's see."

[Kunal does his homework at the table.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Kunal types on his laptop.]

Hema (gently): "Kunal, are you okay?"

[Kunal opens the door and goes out.]

Kunal (surprised): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal walks across the courtyard.]

Kunal: "Careful!"

[Kunal stamps his foot in anger.]

Hema: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Kunal (laughing): "Exactly right."

[Kunal feeds the dog.]

Hema (excited): "Oh wow!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal pats his horse.]

Kunal (laughing): "What next?"

[Kunal bumps his head on the door frame and his forehead bleeds.]

Kunal: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
